prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Wide tabletop model composed along the horizontal centre line: at the left a loose cluster of rough unfinished white six-sided hexagon tiles, at the centre tiles locking into a regular deep blue honeycomb, and at the right a tidy stack of blue hexagon tiles. Subject spread along the horizontal centre line with wide quiet margins left and right. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: the top tile of the stack at the right, in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
